model_annotation: The image displays a donut chart with two concentric rings, each representing a different category of ambiguity metrics. The outer ring, labeled "Ambiguity Std (Outer)," is divided into four segments corresponding to standard deviation values: Std: 0.0 (dark blue, 49.0%), Std: 0.47 (medium-dark blue, 47.7%), Std: 0.82 (medium blue, 7.0%), and Std: 0.94 (light blue, 5.0%). The inner ring, labeled "Max Ambiguity (Inner)," consists of three segments for maximum ambiguity values: Max: 1 (lightest blue, 39.0%), Max: 2 (light blue, 38.0%), and Max: 3 (very light blue, 14.2%). The percentages are displayed within the respective segments of the chart, and the legend on the right provides a key for the color coding of both the standard deviation and maximum ambiguity categories.
